tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dbyangs can lha mo'i bsgom bzlas shes bya rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥsarba dz+nyā ye/ mkhyen rab chos dbyings nam mkha' la/ /thugs rje'i 'od snang cher rgyas te/ /'gro blo'i mun pa sel mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma dbyangs can dga' ma rgyal/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs cher gsal ba/ /blo dman dga' ba bskyed byed 'di/ /gong ma'i gsung las btus te bshad/ /de la 'dir dpal gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag po'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rdo rje dbyangs can ma dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs bya ba la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes so/ dang po ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su phyag dar dang byi dor legs par byas te/ stegs mtho bar ras dkar gyis bkab la 'bru sna tshogs bcal du bkram/ de'i steng du mañji'i khar sha khrag sgog tsong sogs dang ma 'dres pa'i dkar gtor zlum po mar dkar gyis legs par byugs pa rgyan ci mdzes kyis spras pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bshams/ 'byor na de dag la zhal phyogs par rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sku bris 'bur gang rigs bzhugs su gsol/ rang gi mdun du lcog tse'i steng du ting shags 'thor snod 'bras dkar ram nas dkar gyis bkang ba la sogs pa shom pa ni sngon 'gro'o/ /dngos gzhi la gza' tshes gang bzang gi phyi ma red la babs pa na rang nyid khrus dang gtsang sbra gos bzang gis brgyan te sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu rgyal chen gyi tho spyi dang mthun par btab/ nang du log ste bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam zhi dul gyis 'dug la/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭaḥces pas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las pā d+yaṃ nas shap+ta'i mthar ting shags dkrol te dharma ra ṇi tshar gsum gyis byin dbab/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid mngon sum lta bur dmigs la/ de'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i rang bzhin can du bsam/ skyabs su 'gro mkhan gyi gang zag bdag dang dgra 'dre byur gsum pha ma rigs drug gi sems can thams cad g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab mtha' skor kun tu khrom tshogs pa lta bur bsams la/ dus 'di nas bzung ste snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du bla ma dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum mkhyen snyam pa'i ngang nas bcos ma ma yin pa'i gdung shugs kyis ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la ༞zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig tsam brjod pa'i mthar/ snying khar thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul gyi bla ma de nyid kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ bdag dang skyabs 'gro'i gang zag gi sems can rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs nas sems can rnams rang rang gi zhing du gshegs/ bla ma de nyid 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par zhu nas rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams/

slar yang sems can gyi khams na gnas pa'i 'gro ba phal mo che dag shin tu ya nga ba'i sdug bsngal bdag gis bsgral bar byas nas rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i go 'phang la bkod snyam pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas sems bskyed/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje dbyangs can mar gsal ba'i snying khar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du doḥyig dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje dbyangs can ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya se gol gyi sgra dang bcas pas tshogs zhing spyan drangs/ de nyid la mchod pa dpag tu med pas mchod par bsams la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra swa ra swasti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā nas shap+ta'i bar brjod/ sor mo phan tshun bsnol ba rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar lan gsum brjod pas tshogs zhing gis rigs kyi bu khyod kyi gnas pa 'di la legs par gnas pa ni mchog go zhes gnang ba sbyin par bsam la/ tshogs zhing rnams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas rang gi spyi bo nas thim par bsam pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ de nas ye shes tshogs gsag gi sngon du 'gro ba tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs brjod/ ye shes tshogs gsag gi dngos po ni/ oṃ swa bhā wā sogs brjod do/ /rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams pa ni ye shes tshogs gsag go /de nas bdag lhar bskyed pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid doḥyig dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/

sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan rdo rje dbyangs can ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal dmar ba/ g.yas zhal sngo ba/ g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum na pad+ma/ ral gri/ gri gug g.yon gsum na/ 'khor lo/ rin chen/ thod pa rnams 'dzin pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i doḥyig dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya se gol dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ badz+ra swa ra swasti sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā re sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod lnga yis mchod/ thal mo sbyar la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams can kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣīñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyi dbur brgyan/ thugs khar sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te rang la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/

zhes bsam zhing brjod la shel dkar gyi phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad rgyan dang ldan pa lag pa g.yon pa'i mdzub mo'i steng nas mthe bong nang du drangs la/ sngags ni/ oṃ bde legs/ pi tsu pi tsu 'jam po 'jam po/ pra dz+nyā shes rab/ warda 'phel zhing / ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la 'bar ba 'bar ba/ medha yid gzhung / war+dha 'phel ba/ ni/ dhi ri dhi ri blo gros blo gros/ bud+dhi war+dha 'phel ba/ ni swā hā/ gzhi tshugs/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di thun re la brgya stong khri la sogs pa blos ji tsam nus pa bzla/ bsnyen tshad ni/ 'bum bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa'o/ /thun tshad ni/ thor thun/ snga thun/ dgong thun/ srod thun te thun bzhir nges par bya/ bzlas pa grub nas/ phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod cing kha rlangs btab la spyi bor reg rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gong du bshams pa'i dkar gtor chu gtsang mas sbyangs/ thun gzhan thams cad zan gtsang mas kha gsos/ de dag chus sbyangs/ gtor mgron bskyed pa ni/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ aḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du doḥyig dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dbyangs can ma nas/ bzhugs pa'i bar/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/

de la mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstims/ dbang lha spyan drangs mchod cing gsol ba btab/ dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ pi tsu nas swāhā'i mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod rol mo dharma ra ṇi tshar gcig gis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab rgya mtsho yi/ /rnam par 'phrul pa'i dpal las legs 'ong shing / /sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog ster ma/ /lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbyangs can lha mo 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod/ ༈ /skabs 'dir dbyangs can dkar mo'i rigs 'gre sbyar te nor rgyun ma la gtor ma 'bul na/ slar yang gtor ma de nyid byin gyis rlob pa'am/ yang na zlum gtor gzhan zhig byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal ldan lha mo nor rgyun ma la nor lha gter bdag gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ gyis gdan phul bas rang mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ ba su rdā ri ṇi a kā ro mu khaṃ btags pa gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ ba su dhā ri sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ ting shags dkrol la/ mi zad nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur zhing / /skye dgu'i phongs pa'i sdug bsngal kun sel zhing / /sgrub pa po la dgos 'dod mchog stsol ma/ /lha mo nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor rgyun lha mo 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis phrin las bcol lo/ /yang gtor ma de nyid byin gyis brlabs la/

'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ lo ka pa ཱla sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas phyogs skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas mdun du byon par bsam/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ lo ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra a kā ro mu khaṃ btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ ting shags dkrol la/ 'jig rten pa yi 'byung po rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /chos don bden pa la gnas nas/ /zhi zhing dul ba'i sems su mdzod/ /bdag kyang byang chub ma thob bar/ /gegs med bar chad med pa dang / /dam tshig gnas la gnas mdzod la/ /byang chub thob pa'i grogs kyang mdzod/ /ces phrin las bcol lo/ /de nas yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs/ thal mo sbyar la/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs byas 'di la nyes byas gang / /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /gtso bor nus pa ma mchis shing / /ma 'byor ma rnyed ma btsal ba/ /'dir ni bgyis pa gang bgyis rnams/ /de dag thams cad bzod par gsol/ /me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dang mchod pa'i yul dam pa mdzad nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/ rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra gats+tsha/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ rang dbyangs can lha mor gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dbyangs can ma dpal 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /brtse ldan khyed kyi mkhyen pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /'gro ba'i gti mug mun pa kun gsal nas/ /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i snang ba cher rgyas te/ /gsung rab rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i skal ldan shog /bdag kyang skye ba 'di nas bzung nas su/ /ji srid thams cad mkhyen dbang ma thob bar/ /rje btsun dbyangs can lha mos rjes bzung nas/ /'gro kun phan bde'i sa la 'god par shog /khyad par skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /rmad byung shes bya'i blo gros spobs pa yi/ /'chad rtsod rtsom dang thos bsam bsgom gsum gyis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byed par shog /bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / /lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag sogs kun gyis 'di dang phyi ma'i don/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ting shags dkrol la/ phan bde phun sum tshogs par 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus rje btsun mchog /'gro kun sangs rgyas sa la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /khyab bdag dpal ldan bla ma'i bkra shis shog /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i 'jings las legs thon zhing / /mkhyen brtse'i mkha' la shes bya'i 'od snang 'phro/ /blo gros pad+mo kha 'byed rje btsun ma/ /rta bdun dbyangs can lha mo'i bkra shis shog

/rgyal bstan de 'dzin bcas pa bu bzhin srungs/ /bstan la gnod byed ma rung thal bar rlog /chos bzhin bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor skyong mdzad pa'i/ /dregs byed dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med thos bsam 'phel/ /phyi ma dbyangs can lha mos rjes bzung nas/ /thams cad mkhyen dbang go 'phang mchog thob ste/ /'gro phan dpag med byed pa'i bkra shis shog /de nas nyin mo bde legs sogs brjod/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas dgra nag nas gsungs pa'i dbyangs can lha mo zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs nyams su len tshul 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang gi nye gnas bsod nams 'od zer gyi kha 'don du dmigs nas sbyar ba 'dis kyang bskul ba po'i 'dod pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dbyangs can lha mo'i bsgom bzlas shes bya rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
